book.name: 1ª de Corintios
book.title: Yeets ner kuu mkee Paba lo re zha yez Corinto

content: Re zha kuu nke rtsin Diox

Re goo wetsʼn ne btan na, ngogt ganin lo goo taxal re zha kuu ney ndo nyelaaz Jesucrist, sinke mnin lo goo taxal lo zha yezlyu ree, taxal zha kuu ndediz lo re ndyeen bzhizh, tata mndan kwent chaan Jesucrist lo goo.
Kuu nagant mloon lo goo, tak bee ter yen gooy tsya ne neeka nal bee ter yen gooy; taxal zha kuu ndaa nzii nzhuu mbet, tata mteteedʼn goo, tak lee mbet gagt wu mbet kuu nzhow zha gox,
tak bee naka goo taxal zha yezlyu ree. Bee nayiika nzhak leettsoo goo ne goo tedib goo, ngyodiz goo ne nzhak rol goo. ¿Chu nagt zha yezlyu ree nak goo, leettsa ntsow goo xgab taxal re men yezlyu ree?
Leettsa lee thib goo mbez: “Na ndeke dits Paba”, lee tedib goo mbez: “Na ndeke dits Apolos”, taxal zha yezlyu ree ndediz goo, leettsa tabaa mbez goo.
Ne, ¿cho nak Paba? Ne ¿cho nak Apolos? Beeta zha kuu nke rtsin Diox nak nee, ne mtsow nee ngwalaaz goo Zha Nabee. Ne kadta thib nee ntsow nee tsiin kuu mndaa Zha Nabee tsow nee.
Nal nin naa xomod nake; leettsa mndan kwent xkiiz Diox lo re goo, kona nak taxal na mloo mbiz lo yu; ne leettsa mteteed Apolos goo, kona nak taxal mlaal Apolos bin, per Diox nak kuu nxeene.
Kona, neeka zha kuu ngo bin ne neeka zha kuu nlaale nataagt zha, sinke Diox nataak, tak lee Diox nxeen reta kwaa.
Kona lee zha kuu ngo bin ne zha kuu nlaale, lalta nataak zha, ne Diox kix lo kadta thib zha por tsiin kuu mtsow zha.
Ne rtsin Diox nke rop altaa nee, ne lee goo nak taxal yezlyu ta nke Diox tsiin. Noga, nak goo taxal thib yuu kuu ngetaa Diox.
Diox mndaa yalnzhaak lon, kona nakʼn taxal thib maestr lo re zha kuu nta yuu. Na mtob simyent ne lee tedib zha nak kuu nta yuu. Per kadta thib zha ndoblo wii zha naa xomod ta zhay.
Ne yent raa cho ndoblo tob tedib simyent lo simyent kuu ndoba, tak lee simyent kuu ndoba nak Jesucrist.
Ne dits simyent ree, tak ta zha thib yuu or o yuu plat o tak ta zhay kon ke kuu chul na, kon ya, kon yizh o kon yi.
Per leettsa tsin wiz kuu naab Diox kwent, tsya yanabee rtsin kadta thib zha, tak wiza lee Diox taal bel, ne kon bel gak preb rtsin kadta thib zha.
Os lee thib zha mdexkwaa thib yuu kuu xek lo ki, tekayaa zha kuu kix Diox lo zha.
Ne os lee yuu kuu mdexkwaa zha yek, tsa mluux zha reta chaan zha, per taxal zha kuu nlaa lo ki telaa Diox zha.
Noga ndoblo ne goo, leeʼaa nak gwodoo chaan Diox, ne lee Mbi Nayon chaan Diox nzo leettsooʼaa.
Ne os cho luux gwodoo chaan Diox, lee Diox luux zhaʼa, tak nayon nak gwodoo chaan Diox, ne goo nak gwodooʼa.
Kedit goo leeka goo; os lee thib goo ndak goo nzhaak goo re kuu yezlyu ree, ndoblo tsow goo taxal thib zha kuu neeka thib kuu gagt, tsasi lee Diox wlipaa taa yalnzhaak lo goo.
Tak lee yalnzhaak yezlyu ree nak kuu naxen lo Diox. Taxal nzhab lo xkeets Diox: “Leeka lo yalnzhaak chaan zha nden Diox zha”. [Job 5:13]
Ne noga nzhabe: “Lee Zha Nabee neʼa zha lee xgab re zha kuu nzhaak thitanax nataagte”. [Sal. 94:11]
Kona neeka thib goo ndoblot rub goo, tak ngeteed goo lo thib zha kuu nataak, tak reta kuu nak chaan goo:
reta kuu mloo Paba lo goo, re kuu mloo Apolos lo goo o re kuu mloo Pey lo goo, yezlyu, yalnaban, yalguth, kuu nzo nal ne kuu yo bluz, reta koree nak chaan goo,
ne reta goo nak zha Jesucrist, ne lee Jesucrist nak zha Diox.
